notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Budoka Gardener.
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control eight or less lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

uses.name: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life
